helpCenter.title: Help Center
helpCenter.intro: Answers to common questions about using {{app}}. Can't find what you need? Contact us below.

faqs.q: How do I create an account or sign in?
faqs.a: Open the app and use the Sign up screen to register with your email and a password, or Log in if you already have an account. You'll receive a confirmation email — tap the link inside to activate your account.

faqs.q: How do I edit my name, photo, email or password?
faqs.a: Go to Settings → Profile to update your first and last name, phone, address and region. You can change your email or password there under Security. To set a profile photo, tap your avatar at the top of the Settings screen.

faqs.q: How do I save a university or program?
faqs.a: Tap the heart icon on any university to add it to your Favourites. Open the Favourites tab to see everything you've saved and to compare universities side by side.

faqs.q: How do I change the language or turn on dark mode?
faqs.a: Go to Settings → Language to switch between English and Bulgarian, and Settings → Appearance to choose Light, Dark or System theme.

faqs.q: What do the accessibility settings do?
faqs.a: Settings → Accessibility lets you Reduce Motion (turns off animations) and turn on Large Text (bigger text on the information screens). Your choices are saved on your device.

faqs.q: How do I manage marketing emails?
faqs.a: Go to Settings → Email Notifications and turn each category on or off. Essential account and security emails are always sent.

faqs.q: Some university or tuition information looks wrong. What should I do?
faqs.a: University details such as programs, tuition and deadlines can change over time. Always confirm on the university's official website before applying. If something looks incorrect, email us and we'll review it.

faqs.q: How do I delete my account and data?
faqs.a: Go to Settings and tap Delete Account at the bottom. This permanently removes your account and associated data and cannot be undone.

faqs.q: How is my personal data handled?
faqs.a: See our Privacy Policy (Settings → Privacy Policy) for what we collect, how we use it and your rights. You can request access to or deletion of your data at any time.

helpCenter.contactBody: Email our support team and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.

about.title: About {{app}}
about.tagline: Discover universities and programs — all in one place.
paragraphs: {{app}} helps students explore universities and study programs, compare their options and keep track of the ones they love. Browse by field of study, degree, location and scholarship availability, then open a university to see quick facts, its programs and a link to the official website.
Save any university or program to your Favourites so you can find it again later and compare choices side by side. The app is available in English and Bulgarian, with light and dark themes.
features: Browse and search universities and programs
Filter by degree, category, country and scholarships
Manage your profile, language and appearance
Use it in English or Bulgarian, light or dark

sections.heading: 2. Eligibility

You must not: copy, scrape or harvest data from the app; attempt to reverse engineer, disrupt or gain unauthorised access to the app or its systems; upload unlawful, offensive or infringing content; or impersonate anyone or otherwise misuse the app in a way that harms us or other users.

This information may change and may contain errors or be out of date, and it is not official advice. {{app}} is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official representative of any university listed.

You may not use our name, branding or content without our prior written permission. University names, logos and materials remain the property of their respective owners.

sections.heading: 8. Third-party links and services

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data {{app}} collects, how we use it, who we share it with, and the rights you have. By using the app you agree to the practices described here.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are (data controller)
paragraphs: {{app}} is operated by {{entity}}, the data controller responsible for your personal data. If you have any questions, contact us at {{email}}.

sections.heading: 2. Information we collect
paragraphs: Account information you give us: your email address, your password (stored in encrypted/hashed form by our authentication provider), and optionally your first and last name, profile photo, phone number, postal address and account region.
Content you create: the universities and programs you save as favourites, and your app preferences (language, theme, accessibility and email choices — some of these are stored only on your device).
Technical information: the basic data needed to run the app securely, such as the app version and authentication logs handled by our provider. The app does not track your location.

sections.heading: 3. How we use your data
paragraphs: We use your personal data to: create and secure your account; provide core features such as your profile and saved favourites; remember your preferences; respond to your support requests; send essential service emails (for example, email confirmation and password resets); and, only if you opt in, send product updates or promotional emails.
We do not sell your personal data.

sections.heading: 4. Legal bases for processing
paragraphs: Where the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) applies, we process your data on these bases: performance of our contract with you (to provide the app and your account); your consent (for optional marketing emails, which you can withdraw at any time); our legitimate interests (to keep the app secure and to improve it); and compliance with legal obligations.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing your data
paragraphs: We share data only with trusted service providers who help us run the app — in particular our backend provider Supabase, which hosts our database, authentication and file storage. These providers process data on our behalf under agreements that protect your information. We may also disclose data where required by law or to protect our rights and our users. We do not sell your data or share it for third-party advertising.

sections.heading: 6. Storage, security and international transfers
paragraphs: Your data is stored with our backend provider and transmitted over encrypted (HTTPS) connections. We apply access controls and rely on our providers' security measures. Some providers may process data outside your country, including outside the European Economic Area; where they do, appropriate safeguards (such as Standard Contractual Clauses) are used.

sections.heading: 7. How long we keep your data
paragraphs: We keep your personal data for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, we delete or anonymise the associated data, except where we are required to keep certain information to meet legal obligations.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you have the right to: access the personal data we hold about you; correct inaccurate data; delete your data (the "right to be forgotten"); restrict or object to certain processing; receive your data in a portable format; and withdraw consent at any time. You can exercise many of these rights directly in the app — edit your profile, manage your email preferences, or delete your account in Settings — or by emailing us at {{email}}.
If you are in the EU, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority (in {{country}}, the Commission for Personal Data Protection).

sections.heading: 9. Children's privacy
paragraphs: The app is not intended for children under {{age}}. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under this age. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: 10. Third-party links
paragraphs: The app contains links to external websites, such as university websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites; please review their own privacy policies.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will change the "Last updated" date above and, where appropriate, notify you in the app.

sections.heading: 12. Contact us
paragraphs: For any privacy questions or to make a data request, contact us at {{email}}.

universityExtra.vum_referFriend: "Refer a Friend" reward programme for students who bring new applicants

universityExtra.vum_recognition: Dual Bulgarian and British (Cardiff Metropolitan University) diplomas recognised internationally
universityExtra.su_scholarshipsDesc: As a state university, Sofia University keeps tuition low for Bulgarian and EU students and offers a range of merit- and need-based support:
universityExtra.su_meritScholarships: Merit scholarships from the state budget for full-time students with a strong grade-point average, plus special and named (donor) scholarships
universityExtra.su_socialScholarships: Social (need-based) scholarships, support for students from vulnerable groups, and one-off assistance in special circumstances
universityExtra.su_erasmusGrants: Erasmus+ mobility grants for study or traineeship abroad at hundreds of partner universities, plus Transform4Europe alliance opportunities
universityExtra.su_phdScholarships: State scholarships for full-time doctoral candidates and paid participation in national and European research projects
universityExtra.su_studentLoans: State-guaranteed, low-interest student loans for Bulgarian and EU students under the Student and Doctoral Loans Act
universityExtra.su_applicationDesc: Admission is organised by the university each summer, with separate tracks for Bulgarian/EU and non-EU applicants:
universityExtra.su_appEuExam: Bulgarian and EU applicants are ranked by a composite score from state matriculation exams and/or Sofia University entrance examinations
universityExtra.su_appNonEu: Non-EU applicants are admitted on the basis of their documents, provided the relevant grade is at least 62% of the maximum in their country's system
universityExtra.su_appMedicine: Medicine and Pharmacy applicants sit competitive entrance exams in Biology and Chemistry (with English for the English-taught programmes)
universityExtra.su_appDocuments: Required documents include the secondary-school diploma (with NACID recognition for foreign diplomas), an application form, ID/passport and a medical certificate
universityExtra.su_appDeadlines: Applications are typically submitted from June to August, with ranking rounds in July–September for the autumn start
universityExtra.su_appOnline: Bulgarian/EU candidates apply through the online admission system (priem.uni-sofia.bg); foreign students apply via the International Relations Office (intdept@admin.uni-sofia.bg)
universityExtra.su_masterFeesDesc: Fees for 2025/2026 are indicative and depend on the programme, language and student category; exact amounts are set annually by Rector's order and paid in two semester instalments:
universityExtra.su_feeSubsidised: Bulgarian and EU students: state-subsidised places from about €230 per year, or paid places set per field (higher for professional and regulated programmes)
universityExtra.su_feeForeignBachelor: Foreign (non-EU) students: bachelor programmes taught in Bulgarian from roughly €2,800 per year
universityExtra.su_feeForeignMaster: Foreign (non-EU) students: master programmes from roughly €3,600 per year
universityExtra.su_feeMedicine: Medicine and Pharmacy taught in English: about €7,700 per year for international students
universityExtra.su_feePrep: Specialised one-year Bulgarian-language and subject preparatory course: €3,500
universityExtra.su_feePayment: Annual tuition is paid in two equal halves at the start of each semester; an 80% refund applies to withdrawals before 1 October, and dual (Bulgarian) citizens pay reduced rates
universityExtra.su_campusDesc: The university is spread across historic and modern buildings in central Sofia and beyond:
universityExtra.su_rectorate: The landmark Rectorate (1924–1934) on Tsar Osvoboditel Boulevard — over 18,000 m² and 324 rooms — funded by the benefactors Evlogi and Hristo Georgiev
universityExtra.su_libraries: The University Library, the largest and oldest academic library in Bulgaria, with millions of volumes
universityExtra.su_insait: Modern research institutes including INSAIT (Institute for Computer Science, AI and Technology), which won Bulgaria's first ERC grant
universityExtra.su_botanicalGarden: A University Botanical Garden, astronomical observatories and specialised science laboratories and clinics
universityExtra.su_dormitories: Student dormitories in the Studentski Grad complex, canteens, sports facilities and student organisations
universityExtra.su_partnersDesc: Sofia University is Bulgaria's most internationally connected university:
universityExtra.su_erasmusNetwork: Hundreds of Erasmus+ inter-institutional agreements for student and staff mobility across Europe
universityExtra.su_transform4europe: Founding member of the Transform4Europe European University Alliance
universityExtra.su_researchRankings: Ranked the No. 1 university in Bulgaria and listed in the QS World University Rankings, with strong performance in the natural and social sciences
universityExtra.su_alumni: Alumni include Bulgarian presidents, prime ministers, academicians, writers and leading scientists
universityExtra.su_bilateral: Bilateral cooperation agreements with partner universities and research centres worldwide
universityExtra.su_internationalDesc: Sofia University welcomes international students and offers dedicated support:
universityExtra.su_englishPrograms: Degree programmes in English and other foreign languages, including Medicine and Pharmacy, alongside a wide Bulgarian-taught offering
universityExtra.su_bulgarianPrep: A one-year specialised preparatory course in Bulgarian language and subject preparation for foreign applicants
universityExtra.su_visaSupport: Admission, visa and residence support for foreign students through the International Relations Office
universityExtra.su_accommodation: Assistance with accommodation in university dormitories and integration through student organisations
universityExtra.su_recognition: NACID recognition of foreign diplomas and internationally recognised Sofia University degrees

universityExtra.tus_socialScholarships: Social (need-based) scholarships and support for students from vulnerable groups
universityExtra.tus_companyScholarships: Corporate scholarships and paid internships from technology partners such as Bosch, SAP, VMware, Festo and Siemens

universityExtra.tus_studentLoans: State-guaranteed, low-interest student loans for Bulgarian and EU students

universityExtra.tus_dormitories: Student dormitories in the Studentski Grad campus, canteens and student services

universityExtra.tus_branches: Campuses in Sofia, Plovdiv and Sliven, plus colleges in Sofia, Botevgrad, Kazanlak and beyond

universityExtra.unwe_feeForeignEn: Foreign (non-EU) bachelor in English: about €1,900 per semester (€3,800 per year)
universityExtra.unwe_feeLawMaster: Foreign Law master (Bulgarian): about €2,000 per semester (€4,000 per year); dual (Bulgarian) citizens pay 50% less

universityExtra.mus_alexandrovska: The historic Alexandrovska University Hospital, a principal clinical and teaching base

universityExtra.mus_researchLabs: Preclinical and research laboratories across the Medicine, Dental and Pharmacy faculties

universityExtra.mus_ranking: Ranked among the leading universities in Emerging Europe & Central Asia (QS)

universityExtra.mus_bilateral: Bilateral agreements with universities and hospitals across Europe, the Middle East and beyond
universityExtra.mus_internationalDesc: MU-Sofia has a long tradition of educating international students (around 800 from many countries):

universityExtra.mus_visaSupport: Admission, visa and residence support through the International Relations & Foreign Students Department
universityExtra.mus_prepCourse: A preparatory Bulgarian-language course is available for foreign applicants
universityExtra.mus_accommodation: Assistance with accommodation in university dormitories and student services
universityExtra.mus_recognition: NACID recognition of foreign diplomas and internationally recognised MU-Sofia degrees
universityExtra.nbu_scholarshipsDesc: As a private university, NBU funds studies through tuition, but offers merit awards and a wide range of discounts:

universityExtra.nbu_socialDiscount: 50% discount for students with a disability (50%+ reduced working capacity) and for full orphans under 26
universityExtra.nbu_alumniDiscount: 25% discount on the first master's semester for NBU bachelor graduates continuing without interruption
universityExtra.nbu_erasmusGrants: Erasmus+ mobility grants for study or traineeship abroad at partner universities

universityExtra.nbu_appForeign: Foreign applicants apply through the International Students Office (foreign.student@nbu.bg)
