Online application via the UniBIT admission portal at apply.unibit.bg

17.name: Todor Kableshkov University of Transport
17.focus: railway, automotive and transport engineering, rolling stock and construction machinery, transport construction, electric transport and electric vehicles, telecommunications and signalling, transport economics, logistics and management
17.style: engineering laboratory and workshop practice, applied transport research, internships with railways and transport operators, and Erasmus+ mobility
admissionNotes: Bulgarian and EU applicants are admitted by a competitive score from a VTU entrance test in mathematics and/or state matriculation exams
Many specialties admit directly on the secondary-school diploma and matriculation results
Foreign (non-EU) applicants apply as international students; a preparatory year in Bulgarian is available
Orphans, students with severe disabilities and war-affected students are exempt from tuition
Application through the VTU admission office; see vtu.bg for dates and details

18.name: University of Telecommunications and Post
18.focus: telecommunications and network technologies, computer technologies and software, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, digital entrepreneurship, digital public administration and management
18.style: hands-on laboratory work, Cisco and AWS academy training, industry internships with A1, Huawei and Siemens, and Erasmus+ mobility, with strong graduate employability
admissionNotes: Bulgarian and EU applicants are admitted mainly on secondary-school diploma grades, usually without an entrance exam
A minimum diploma score of about 62% of the maximum is required
Foreign applicants apply as international students with a recognised diploma and proof of language
Orphans, students with severe disabilities and war-affected students are exempt from tuition
Online or on-site application via the UTP admission office; see utp.bg

19.name: University of Insurance and Finance (VUZF)
19.focus: finance, banking and investment, insurance and risk, accounting and audit, fintech and digital finance, management, marketing and digital business, and green economics
19.style: practical, career-focused teaching by working professionals, applied projects with the VUZF Lab, English-taught options, internships in banks and financial firms, and Erasmus+ mobility
admissionNotes: Bachelor applicants are admitted on their secondary-school diploma, without an entrance exam
Rolling admission with intakes through the year; a master's requires a completed bachelor's degree
English-taught programmes require proof of English language proficiency
As a private university, VUZF charges per-semester fees with scholarships, discounts and instalments
Online application via the VUZF admission system at uzf.bg

20.name: National Sports Academy "Vasil Levski"
20.focus: sport and coaching, physical education and PE teaching, sports management, adapted physical activity, sports journalism, kinesitherapy and rehabilitation, ergotherapy and sports animation
20.style: practical training on the academy's stadiums, halls, pool and clinics, coaching and sport-specific practice, applied sports science, and Erasmus+ mobility, with several programmes offered in English
admissionNotes: Most specialties require a practical entrance examination testing physical and sporting ability
Admission also uses the secondary-school diploma and state matriculation results
Foreign (non-EU) applicants apply as international students with a recognised diploma and medical certificate
Kinesitherapy and selected programmes are offered in English for international students
Application through the NSA admission campaign; see nsa.bg for dates and the entrance-exam schedule

21.name: VSU "Lyuben Karavelov"
21.focus: civil and structural engineering, construction of buildings and facilities, construction management, fire safety, architecture and urban design, and the combined engineer-architect qualification
21.style: studio-based architecture and design work, construction and structural-testing laboratories, site and applied practice, and Erasmus+ mobility, with some programmes taught in English
admissionNotes: Bulgarian and EU applicants are admitted by a composite score from state matriculation exams and/or a VSU entrance exam
Architecture includes an entrance examination in drawing
Construction Engineering and Construction Management are also offered in English
Foreign (non-EU) applicants apply as international students with a recognised diploma
Online or on-site application via the VSU admission office at priem.vsu.bg

22.name: National Academy of Art
22.focus: painting, mural painting, sculpture, graphics and print, poster and visual communication, scenography, conservation and restoration, art studies, and applied arts and design (ceramics, textiles, fashion, industrial and advertising design, photography)
22.style: studio- and atelier-based creative practice, exhibitions and public shows, work with master artists, and Erasmus+ mobility and international residencies
admissionNotes: Admission is by competitive creative entrance examinations (drawing, composition and specialty tasks)
A portfolio of artworks is required or recommended for most specialties
Foreign applicants apply as international students with a portfolio and language proof
Both bachelor's and master's specialties are offered across fine and applied arts
Application through the NHA admission campaign; see nha.bg for dates and requirements

23.name: National Academy of Music
23.focus: instrumental performance, classical, chamber and pop & jazz singing, composition, opera-symphony and choral conducting, musicology, music pedagogy, Bulgarian folk music, ballet, sound engineering and music management
23.style: one-to-one studio tuition with leading musicians, ensemble and orchestral practice, recitals and public concerts, the academy's symphony orchestra, choir and opera theatre, and Erasmus+ mobility
admissionNotes: Admission is by competitive practical entrance examinations in the chosen specialty
Instrumentalists and singers perform a prepared programme before an examination jury
Foreign applicants apply as international students; an audition or recording and language proof may be required
Both bachelor's and master's specialties are offered across the three faculties
Application through the NMA admission campaign; see nma.bg for dates and requirements

24.name: Rakovski National Defence College
24.focus: national security and defence, strategic and operational leadership, command and staff, security and defence management, corporate and aviation security, counter-terrorism, critical-infrastructure protection, cybersecurity, defence logistics and security psychology
24.style: postgraduate military and civilian education, staff rides and command-post exercises, NATO-oriented training, applied defence research at DARI, and Erasmus+ mobility
admissionNotes: State-funded military places are filled by competitive entrance exams; officers are assigned by the Ministry of Defence
Civilian applicants may apply for state-subsidised places (exam-based) or paid places (document-based)
Master's applicants need a relevant prior degree; some fields expect security or military experience
Programmes are offered full-time, part-time and by distance learning
Application through the Rakovski admission campaign; see rndc.bg for dates and requirements

25.name: National Academy of Theatre and Film Arts
25.focus: drama and puppet-theatre acting, movement theatre, performing-arts directing, scenography, theatre studies and management, film and TV directing, cinematography, editing, sound, producing and design, screenwriting, photography, animation and screen research
25.style: studio- and stage-based creative practice, full theatre productions and student films, work with master artists, festivals and public showcases, and Erasmus+ and FilmEU mobility
admissionNotes: Admission is by competitive creative entrance examinations (auditions, screen tests and specialty tasks)
Most screen and design specialties require a portfolio or a body of creative work
Foreign applicants apply as international students with a portfolio or audition and language proof
Both bachelor's and master's specialties are offered across stage and screen arts
Application through the NATFA admission campaign; see natfiz.bg for dates and requirements

26.name: Academy of the Ministry of the Interior
26.focus: counteraction to crime and public order, protection of national security, border police, strategic security and public-order management, psychological support for operational-investigative work, public administration, and fire safety and civil protection
26.style: police and security education for cadets and civilians, field and tactical training, work with the structures of the Ministry of the Interior, applied security research, and Erasmus+ / CEPOL cooperation
admissionNotes: Cadet places are filled by competitive entrance exams plus medical and physical-fitness tests; graduates are appointed in the Ministry of the Interior
Civilian applicants may apply for state-subsidised places (exam-based) or paid student places
Master's applicants need a relevant prior degree; some fields expect service experience
Programmes are offered full-time and part-time / distance learning
Application through the Academy admission campaign; see mvr.bg/academy for dates and requirements

27.name: Luben Groys Theatre College
27.focus: acting for drama theatre and for film — voice, movement, role-building, stage and screen performance, and practical studio work with leading directors and actors
27.style: small, intensive acting studios, public productions and screen projects, mentoring by professional directors and actors, and strongly practical training
admissionNotes: Admission is by a competitive creative audition in three rounds
Candidates prepare poetry, a fable, a prose excerpt, two contrasting monologues, a song and a dance
A secondary-school diploma and a medical certificate are required
The programme is a three-year professional bachelor's in acting
Application through the college; see lgroys-college.com for exam dates and requirements

28.name: MT&M College
28.focus: marketing, advertising and communications, digital marketing, international marketing, trade and entrepreneurship, with an emphasis on practical, digital and AI-in-business skills
28.style: flexible, practical and project-based education, small groups, close links with a Danish partner college, and a strong focus on employability for busy professionals and graduates
admissionNotes: Open to all secondary-school graduates, with autumn and spring intakes
Selection is by an aptitude test, an English placement test and a motivation interview
Full-time and part-time forms of study are available
The programme is a three-year professional bachelor's
Application through the college; see mtmcollege.org for dates and requirements

29.name: South-West University "Neofit Rilski"
29.focus: a broad classical education across law, economics, humanities, natural sciences, health, sport, the arts and engineering
29.style: academic teaching backed by research, art studios, health-care and speech-therapy centres, sports facilities and Erasmus+ mobility across Europe
admissionNotes: Ranking by state matriculation exam grades or a university entrance exam
Several competitive admission rounds, mainly in the summer
Online application through the university candidate-student system
Some specialties (arts, sport, health) have an aptitude or practical exam
Separate procedure and Bulgarian-language check for foreign applicants

30.name: American University in Bulgaria
30.focus: an American-style liberal-arts education across business, economics, computer science, politics, journalism, humanities and mathematics, taught entirely in English
30.style: small classes, interdisciplinary study, double majors, a US-accredited degree, an international campus and strong career and graduate-school outcomes
careers: Graduate study at top universities worldwide
admissionNotes: Rolling admission for autumn and spring, assessed holistically
Proof of English proficiency (TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo) or an AUBG English test
Application essay and a recommendation letter; SAT optional
All programmes taught in English and awarded as a US-style Bachelor of Arts
Merit- and need-based financial aid available; apply early for a tuition waiver

31.name: College of Tourism – Blagoevgrad
31.focus: hotel and restaurant management, tourist services, tourist animation and tour guiding, and business administration for the tourism industry
31.style: a practical, career-focused professional-bachelor education with internships in hotels and resorts, e-learning and Erasmus+ mobility
admissionNotes: Open to secondary-school graduates, ranked by state matriculation grades
Full-time (redovno) and part-time (zadochno) forms of study
A three-year professional-bachelor degree in tourism or business
Internships in partner hotels, restaurants and tour operators
Apply at the college's academic department; autumn intake

32.name: University of Plovdiv "Paisii Hilendarski"
32.focus: a broad classical education strong in the natural sciences, mathematics and informatics, alongside economics, law, philology and teacher education
32.style: research-backed teaching, modern science and computing labs, an observatory, Erasmus+ mobility and strong links with IT and biotech employers
admissionNotes: Ranking by state matriculation exam grades or a university entrance exam
Several competitive admission rounds, mainly in the summer
Online application through the university candidate-student system
Selected programmes taught in English; most in Bulgarian
Separate procedure and Bulgarian-language check for foreign applicants

33.name: Medical University of Plovdiv
33.focus: medicine, dental medicine, pharmacy, nursing, public health and allied health professions, taught in Bulgarian and English
33.style: hospital-based clinical training on a ~2,000-bed base, a modern simulation centre, research institutes and strong international programmes
admissionNotes: Ranking by biology and chemistry results (matriculation or entrance exams)
English-programme applicants sit an entrance test in biology and chemistry
Medicine, Dental Medicine and Pharmacy are 5–6-year integrated master's programmes
A medical certificate is required; clinical placements are part of study
Foreign students apply through the International Welcome Center
Strong biology and chemistry background is useful
Practical experience matters in this field

business.keyFocus: business analysis, leadership, and strategic decision-making
admissionNotes: Math, communication, and problem-solving help a lot
Internships can improve your profile

maritime.keyFocus: maritime systems, transport operations, and technical control
admissionNotes: Comfort with technical and operational work is important
Field practice is a core part of training

tech.keyFocus: digital systems, coding, automation, and applied technology
admissionNotes: Programming or math interest helps
Projects and labs usually matter more than memorization

engineering.keyFocus: engineering design, applied science, and technical problem solving
admissionNotes: Math and physics are usually important
Practical projects are central to the course

general.keyFocus: specialized academic development and practical skill building
admissionNotes: Check the exact entrance requirements for this track
Project work and steady performance are important

22:bachelor:painting.overview: Painting at NHA is a cornerstone of Bulgaria's oldest art academy, developing artists' skills in composition, colour and a personal visual language.
22:bachelor:painting.keyFocus: Painting techniques, composition, colour, drawing and personal artistic expression
highlights: Studio training with leading Bulgarian painters
A foundation for a career as a professional artist
admissionNotes: Admission by creative entrance exams in drawing, painting and composition
A portfolio of artworks is recommended

22:bachelor:sculpture.overview: Sculpture at NHA trains artists to work in three dimensions across stone, metal, wood, clay and modern materials.
22:bachelor:sculpture.keyFocus: Modelling, carving, casting, form and space, and monumental sculpture
22:bachelor:sculpture.duration: Bachelor — 4 years (8 semesters), full-time; studio- and workshop-based
highlights: Work across traditional and modern materials
admissionNotes: Admission by creative entrance exams in drawing and modelling
A portfolio of artworks is recommended

22:bachelor:graphics.overview: Graphics at NHA covers printmaking and graphic art — from etching and lithography to contemporary print and digital techniques.
22:bachelor:graphics.keyFocus: Printmaking, etching, lithography, drawing and graphic composition
highlights: Careers in fine-art print and illustration
admissionNotes: Admission by creative entrance exams in drawing and composition
A portfolio of artworks is recommended

22:bachelor:fashion.overview: Fashion at NHA trains fashion designers, combining creative design with garment construction, and is showcased in the academy's celebrated annual fashion shows.
22:bachelor:fashion.keyFocus: Fashion design, garment construction, textiles, and collection development
partners: Faculty of Applied Arts and Design, NHA
highlights: The academy's renowned annual fashion shows
A pathway into the fashion industry
admissionNotes: Admission by creative entrance exams in drawing, composition and design
A portfolio of designs is recommended

22:bachelor:conservation-and-restoration.overview: Conservation and Restoration at NHA trains specialists to preserve and restore paintings, murals, sculptures and cultural artefacts.
22:bachelor:conservation-and-restoration.keyFocus: Conservation science, restoration techniques, art history and materials
22:bachelor:conservation-and-restoration.duration: Bachelor — 4 years (8 semesters), full-time; studio- and laboratory-based
highlights: Combines art skills with conservation science
admissionNotes: Admission by creative entrance exams and drawing
An interest in art history and materials is an advantage

22:master:scenography.overview: The Scenography master's at NHA specialises artists in stage, set and costume design for theatre, film and performance.
22:master:scenography.keyFocus: Stage and set design, costume design, spatial concept and visual storytelling
22:master:scenography.duration: Master's — 2-3 semesters, full-time; studio- and project-based
highlights: Design for theatre, opera, film and performance
admissionNotes: Requires a bachelor's degree in art or design, with a portfolio
A background in visual arts or theatre is an advantage

22:master:industrial-design.overview: The Industrial Design master's at NHA develops designers of products, objects and environments, combining creativity with function and manufacturing.
22:master:industrial-design.keyFocus: Product design, prototyping, materials and manufacturing, and user-centred design
22:master:industrial-design.duration: Master's — 2-3 semesters, full-time; studio- and workshop-based
partners: Faculty of Applied Arts and Design, NHA
highlights: Careers across the design and manufacturing industry
admissionNotes: Requires a bachelor's degree in design or a related field, with a portfolio
A design or technical background is an advantage

22:master:advertising-design.overview: The Advertising Design master's at NHA trains designers for visual communication, branding and advertising across print and digital media.
22:master:advertising-design.keyFocus: Graphic and advertising design, branding, typography and visual communication
22:master:advertising-design.duration: Master's — 2-3 semesters, full-time; studio- and project-based
partners: Faculty of Applied Arts and Design, NHA
highlights: Focus on branding and visual communication
Strong demand in the creative industries
admissionNotes: Requires a bachelor's degree in design or a related field, with a portfolio
A graphic-design background is an advantage

22:master:art-studies.overview: The Art Studies master's at NHA develops art historians, critics and curators, studying the theory and history of art.
22:master:art-studies.keyFocus: Art history, theory and criticism, curatorship and cultural heritage
highlights: The theory-and-history counterpart to NHA's studio arts
Careers in museums, galleries and academia
admissionNotes: Requires a bachelor's degree; a humanities or arts background is recommended
An interest in art history and theory is essential

23:bachelor:piano.overview: Piano at NMA is one of the academy's flagship specialties, developing concert pianists through intensive one-to-one tuition with leading Bulgarian performers.
23:bachelor:piano.keyFocus: Solo piano repertoire, technique, interpretation, chamber music and accompaniment
23:bachelor:piano.duration: Bachelor — 4 years (8 semesters), full-time; individual instruction
partners: The academic symphony orchestra and concert halls
highlights: One-to-one lessons with renowned concert pianists
A foundation for a career as a soloist or accompanist
admissionNotes: Admission by a practical entrance exam — a prepared piano programme before a jury
A strong prior level of instrumental training is expected

23:bachelor:violin.overview: Violin at NMA trains orchestral and solo violinists through individual tuition, ensemble playing and orchestral practice.
23:bachelor:violin.keyFocus: Violin repertoire, technique, interpretation, chamber and orchestral playing
23:bachelor:violin.duration: Bachelor — 4 years (8 semesters), full-time; individual instruction
highlights: One-to-one lessons with leading string players
Preparation for orchestral auditions and solo careers
admissionNotes: Admission by a practical entrance exam — a prepared violin programme before a jury
A strong prior level of instrumental training is expected

23:bachelor:classical-singing.overview: Classical Singing at NMA prepares opera and concert singers, combining vocal technique with stagecraft, languages and repertoire study.
23:bachelor:classical-singing.keyFocus: Vocal technique, opera and concert repertoire, diction, languages and stage performance
23:bachelor:classical-singing.duration: Bachelor — 4 years (8 semesters), full-time; individual instruction
highlights: One-to-one voice training with experienced singers
Performance in the academy's opera theatre productions
Repertoire in several languages and styles
admissionNotes: Admission by a practical entrance exam — a prepared vocal programme before a jury
A voice assessment and general musicianship test are part of the exam

23:bachelor:composition.overview: Composition at NMA develops composers across classical and contemporary idioms, from chamber and orchestral works to music for stage and screen.
23:bachelor:composition.keyFocus: Composition, orchestration, harmony, counterpoint, music theory and analysis
23:bachelor:composition.duration: Bachelor — 4 years (8 semesters), full-time; individual instruction
partners: Theory, Composition and Conducting Faculty, NMA
The academic symphony orchestra and ensembles
highlights: Performance of student works by academy ensembles
A rigorous grounding in theory and orchestration
admissionNotes: Admission by a creative exam — a portfolio of compositions and theory tests
Strong music-theory and keyboard skills are expected

23:bachelor:pop-and-jazz.overview: Pop and Jazz at NMA trains performers in jazz and popular music — voice or instrument — with improvisation, ensemble playing and studio work.
23:bachelor:pop-and-jazz.keyFocus: Jazz and pop performance, improvisation, harmony, ensemble playing and stage practice
23:bachelor:pop-and-jazz.duration: Bachelor — 4 years (8 semesters), full-time; individual instruction
partners: Jazz clubs, festivals and recording studios
highlights: Specialised training in jazz and popular styles
admissionNotes: Admission by a practical entrance exam — a prepared programme with improvisation
General musicianship and harmony are tested

23:master:opera-and-symphony-conducting.overview: The Opera and Symphony Conducting master's at NMA trains conductors to lead orchestras and opera productions, working with the academy's own ensembles.
23:master:opera-and-symphony-conducting.keyFocus: Orchestral and operatic conducting technique, score reading, rehearsal method and repertoire
23:master:opera-and-symphony-conducting.duration: Master's — 2-4 semesters, full-time; individual instruction and podium practice
partners: Theory, Composition and Conducting Faculty, NMA
The academic symphony orchestra and opera theatre
highlights: Podium time with the academy's symphony orchestra
Work on operatic and symphonic repertoire
admissionNotes: Requires a bachelor's degree in music and strong score-reading skills
Admission by a practical conducting exam before a jury

23:master:musicology.overview: The Musicology master's at NMA develops music scholars, critics and researchers, studying the history, theory and analysis of music.
23:master:musicology.keyFocus: Music history and theory, analysis, research methods, criticism and editing
partners: Theory, Composition and Conducting Faculty, NMA
Music libraries, archives and research institutes
highlights: The scholarly counterpart to NMA's performance specialties
Access to the academy's rare-editions library and sound archive
admissionNotes: Requires a bachelor's degree; a musicology or performance background is recommended
Admission includes a theory and research-oriented exam

23:master:sound-engineering.overview: The Sound Engineering master's at NMA combines musicianship with recording and audio technology, training tonmeisters and music producers.
23:master:sound-engineering.keyFocus: Recording, mixing, sound design, acoustics and music production
partners: Theory, Composition and Conducting Faculty, NMA
The academy's concert halls and ensembles
highlights: A rare blend of trained musicianship and audio engineering
Live and studio production of classical and popular music
admissionNotes: Requires a bachelor's degree; music and technical aptitude are expected
Admission includes a musicianship and audio-oriented exam

23:master:management-of-music-and-perfor.overview: This master's specialty trains managers for the music and performing-arts sector — concert halls, opera houses, festivals, ensembles and cultural projects.
23:master:management-of-music-and-perfor.keyFocus: Arts management, cultural project and event management, marketing, funding and copyright
partners: Theory, Composition and Conducting Faculty, NMA
Concert halls, opera houses and festivals
highlights: A newer specialty combining music expertise with management
Project, event and organisation management for the arts
Careers in concert, opera and festival administration
admissionNotes: Requires a bachelor's degree; a music or arts background is an advantage
Admission includes an interview and a specialty-oriented exam

24:bachelor:security-and-defence.overview: Security and Defence is Rakovski's core bachelor's programme, training officers and civilian specialists in the foundations of national security, defence and the armed forces.
24:bachelor:security-and-defence.keyFocus: National security, defence policy, military organisation, law and leadership fundamentals
24:bachelor:security-and-defence.duration: Bachelor — full-time or part-time; for military and civilian students
partners: Faculty of National Security and Defence, Rakovski
The Ministry of Defence and the Bulgarian Armed Forces
highlights: The academy's flagship entry-level security and defence degree
Taught by serving and former officers and defence experts
A foundation for a career in the armed forces or security sector
admissionNotes: State-funded military places are filled by competitive entrance exams
Civilian applicants may apply for state-subsidised or paid places

24:bachelor:cybersecurity.overview: The Cybersecurity bachelor's at Rakovski prepares specialists to protect information systems and networks in the security and defence sector.
24:bachelor:cybersecurity.keyFocus: Network and information security, cyber defence, cryptography and incident response
24:bachelor:cybersecurity.duration: Bachelor — part-time; for military and civilian students
partners: Faculty of National Security and Defence, Rakovski
The Communication and Information Systems services of the armed forces
highlights: Cyber defence taught in a national-security context
Hands-on work with security tools and simulations
Strong demand across defence, government and industry
admissionNotes: Offered in a part-time form for working students
A technical or IT background is an advantage

24:master:strategic-leadership-of-defenc.overview: This master's — the academy's most senior programme — develops strategic leaders for the defence establishment and the armed forces at the national level.
24:master:strategic-leadership-of-defenc.keyFocus: Defence strategy, national security policy, force planning and senior leadership
24:master:strategic-leadership-of-defenc.duration: Master's — full-time or distance; for senior officers and defence officials
partners: Faculty of Command and Staff, Rakovski
The Ministry of Defence and the General Staff
NATO Defence College and allied institutions
highlights: The top strategic-level course for future defence leaders
Work on real defence-strategy and force-planning problems
Access to senior serving officers and policymakers
admissionNotes: Requires a relevant prior degree and, typically, command experience
Primarily for serving senior officers and defence officials

24:master:national-security-and-defence.overview: National Security and Defence gives a broad master's-level grounding in the policies, institutions and instruments that keep a state secure.
24:master:national-security-and-defence.keyFocus: National security policy, defence institutions, strategy, law and crisis management
partners: Faculty of National Security and Defence, Rakovski
highlights: A comprehensive view of the national-security system
Suitable for both military and civilian professionals
Strong links to Bulgaria's security institutions
admissionNotes: Requires a relevant bachelor's or master's degree
Open to military and civilian applicants

24:master:security-and-defence-managemen.overview: Security and Defence Management trains managers to lead organisations, resources and projects in the security and defence sector.
24:master:security-and-defence-managemen.keyFocus: Security and defence management, resources, projects, and organisational leadership
partners: Faculty of National Security and Defence, Rakovski
The Ministry of Defence and security agencies
highlights: Management skills applied to the defence and security sector
Careers in defence administration and security firms
admissionNotes: Requires a relevant prior degree
